title: Spike: evaluate rate-limited operator signing as spam mitigation
description:
Evaluate rate-limited operator signing as spam mitigation: the transit/reader enforces a configurable per-source-IP or per-AUTHINFO-user POST rate limit. Assess: (1) effectiveness against distributed spam; (2) impact on legitimate high-volume posting; (3) implementation complexity vs Hashcash; (4) interaction with IHAVE bulk import. Artifact: docs/spam_mitigation_ratelimit.md.

Acceptance:
- Quantifies max POST rate per authenticated user
- Documents interaction with IHAVE (bulk import must bypass or have separate limit)
- Compares complexity to Hashcash spike
- Conclusion: recommend adopt/reject with rationale
- No production code written (spike only)
